en.headline: Taiwanese man jailed 12 years and four months for cocaine trafficking
en.dek: High Court Judge Wilson Chan sentenced Miao Chi-hung on his final working day after the defendant admitted bringing 890 grams of cocaine into Hong Kong in wine bottles in 2019.
body: The High Court on Thursday sentenced a Taiwanese man to 12 years and four months in prison for trafficking 890 grams of cocaine into Hong Kong seven years ago.

Miao Chi-hung admitted bringing the drug, concealed in two bottles of red wine, into the city between 4 and 8 August 2019. Judge Wilson Chan set a starting point of 18 and a half years and reduced the term by one third to reflect the guilty plea.
The hearing lasted about 30 minutes and marked Judge Chan’s final public appearance on the bench before his early retirement.

zh.headline: 台灣男子運毒判囚12年4個月 為法官陳嘉信最後一案
zh.dek: 高等法院法官陳嘉信星期四判處台灣男子苗志鴻監禁12年4個月，被告承認2019年以紅酒樽藏有890克可卡因入境，為法官提早退休前最後一次公開聆訊。
body: 高等法院星期四判處一名台灣男子監禁12年4個月，罪名是七年前運送可卡因入境。
苗志鴻承認於2019年8月4日至8日期間，將合共890克可卡因藏於兩個紅酒樽內帶入香港。法官陳嘉信以18年半為量刑起點，因被告認罪扣減三分之一刑期。
聆訊約歷時30分鐘，是陳嘉信法官提早退休前最後一次公開處理案件。
